text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, we plan to use VR to train students
on how to handle unforeseen troubles—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I am your instructor, Tucker Brine!
Pleased to be working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I used to be an instructor at a club,
but now I'm living on a deserted island.
Survival skills came naturally with the territory.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Nature is merciless. Troubles strike without warning.
For example, just like thiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The VR Umulator booted up, projecting a training facility
set amidst the great outdoors.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ugh... M-My head... *pant*, *pant*...
choice_data_list: Are you okay!? ...Wait, it's just VR footage.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Do not treat this as mere training!
She is suffering from heatstroke!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: The medical team will take some time to arrive. Let us administer first aid ourselves!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
She seems to be conscious.
If so, we need to bring her body temperature down first.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the legs, Trainer, you take the head!
Let's move carefully and quickly!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
We can't let our guard down yet!
Get some oral rehydration solution into her, now!!

text_block_list.name: Troop of Monkeys
text_block_list.text: OOK-OOK-EEEEK!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Going after the food, are you...!
I won't let you have it!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaahhh~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Troop of Monkeys
text_block_list.text: Eep?! E-Eeeekkk...!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
All right, oral rehydration solution! 
Bring the drinks, too! Tuck them under her arms!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Tucker Brine handled every trouble with absolute perfection,
and yet――

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!
Did I barely deal with anything at all...?!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Ghh... My apologies.
This is hardly serving as proper training for you.
choice_data_list: No, I should have taken the initiative myself……

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, spoken like a true Tracen Academy trainer!
I am delighted to see such dedication!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Protecting your students――protecting Umamusume,
is your solemn duty as an educator!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
An environment and a future where they can run happily.
Anything that threatens that will be thoroughly eliminated!!
choice_data_list: I'll aim for the same level as Mr. Tucker.
I'll aim for the same level as you, Mr. Tucker.
I will be the one to protect the future of Umamusume!
I'll be the one to protect the future of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:

choice_data_list: I'll aim for the same level as Mr. Tucker.

I'll be the one to protect the future of Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Those are the eyes of true resolve...!
Now that is the face of a true leader!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, it's strict training all the way!
Prepare yourselves! Dahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Nrrgh! Now that's the spirit!
Splendid! Nay, isn't it simply beyond magnificent?!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
With a guide like you, your trainee is in safe hands!
I'm counting on you, Trainer!!
